prompt: A clear editorial-style cutaway illustration of an AI agent at the center of a looping workflow: a language-model “brain” reads a human-set goal card, consults a memory notebook and a planning map, then sends actions through labeled connections to a web browser, spreadsheet, email draft, calendar, and purchasing system; each tool returns results that feed back into the next decision. Show permissions as visible gates or control panels on every connection—some actions allowed, some requiring human approval—and distinguish low-stakes drafting from consequential actions such as placing an order, scheduling a worker, and a personnel recommendation. A human supervisor stands beside the system holding the goal settings and an override switch, emphasizing that the agent’s apparent autonomy is bounded by chosen inputs, access rights, monitoring, and intervention.
